headline: Unifor Launches Unionization Drive for Toronto-Area Amazon Warehouses
summary: Unifor initiated a union drive targeting Amazon warehouses in the Toronto area, citing concerns over working conditions and rising injury rates.
why: Labor union campaigns in major logistics hubs can impact operational structures, labor costs, and corporate workforce relations for large e-commerce employers.
